hypothesis: Missing fields and explicit null are distinct states. Existing field-input tests can supply negative observations, but a complete contract review must establish whether the null substitution preserves every oracle.

semantic_policy.ordering: source candidate ranks round robin over sorted trial names
semantic_policy.interrupted_dispatch: unknown with reserved cost; no retry
semantic_policy.unknown: not executed; not an invalid test judgment

source_policy: Python module-level original repository tests only. Replace one non-None closed scalar field input with None. Support dictionary literals, static subscript assignment and unshadowed builtin dict keywords. Field-key occurrence in the issue is retrieval evidence, not a contract proof. Preserve all original decorators, rows and assertions.
ordering: Original retrieval rank, source path and byte offset, then first 16 candidates per trial. Review in rank-round-robin order. No task/API/path IDs select candidates.
native_policy: First controlled failure, then one repeat; stop even if the repeat does not confirm.
selection_policy: Only complete-test semantic_supported decisions execute, in original fixed rank order. Reject/unknown do not execute. Stop at the first controlled failure and one repeat, regardless of later independent audit.
public_source_boundary: Rebuild review corpus/frontend from repository-origin source bytes. Explicitly record source enrichment and the projection. Preserve original source input receipts; never claim the projected source is the old frozen corpus.
algorithm_repairs: Exact UTF-8 edit offset transport recovers complete function spans after decorator changes. This prevents ten N03 candidates from being silently withheld. The repair is general and not a novelty claim.
Use claim-before-dispatch, raw provider response checks, and sealed native resume artifacts. These establish provenance, not semantic correctness.
novelty: Contribution hypothesis: distinguish absence from present-but-invalid values and transport a full negative test obligation through that state change. Null mutation and static parsing are established components; the contribution requires evidence that the preserved binding and contract gate enable useful tests beyond existing amplification.

validation.scope: Core constructor, driver, repository-only boundary, native resume, provider wire/raw response, decorator UTF-8 transport and compact context regressions

limitations: The generator only covers a bounded Python input shape.
Matching a field name in the issue does not establish field identity, optionality or null illegality.
Model support is a hypothesis. Native failures require independent complete-test review.
Preserving original tests can preserve old oracle errors; the semantic gate must review the whole test.
The source census informed the design. These are development results.
